   300	    def _parse_file(self, fname, fdata, new_files_list):
   301	        try:
   302	            # parse the current file
   303	            data = fdata.read()
   304	            lines = data.splitlines()
   305	            self.metrics.begin(fname)
   306	            self.metrics.count_locs(lines)
   307	            # nosec_lines is a dict of line number -> suppression for the line
   308	            nosec_lines = dict()
   309	            if not self.ignore_nosec:
   310	                enabled_tests = self._get_enabled_tests()
   311	                nosec_lines = nosec.build_nosec_lines(data, enabled_tests)
   312	            score = self._execute_ast_visitor(fname, fdata, data, nosec_lines)
   313	            self.scores.append(score)
   314	            self.metrics.count_issues([score])
   315	        except KeyboardInterrupt:
   316	            sys.exit(2)
   317	        except SyntaxError:
   318	            self.skipped.append(
   319	                (fname, "syntax error while parsing AST from file")
   320	            )
   321	            new_files_list.remove(fname)
   322	        except Exception as e:

   324	                "Exception occurred when executing tests against %s.", fname
   325	            )
   326	            if not LOG.isEnabledFor(logging.DEBUG):
